identity.title: The Detection of Dust Gap-ring Structure in the Outer Region of the CR Cha Protoplanetary Disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: We observe the dust continuum at 225 GHz and CO isotopologue ($^{12}$CO, $^{13}$CO, and C$^{18}$O) $J=2-1$ emission lines toward the CR Cha protoplanetary disk using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

evidence.quote: The latest updated distance of CR Cha is $d\sim187.5\pm0.8\rm~pc$ (cite: GAIA2018).
The latest updated distance of CR Cha is $d\sim187.5\pm0.8\rm~pc$ (cite: GAIA2018).

question.value: Does the CR Cha disk have dust gap/ring substructure, and what mechanism (planet gap opening or dust trapping at a gas temperature/pressure bump) could produce it?

evidence.quote: we show the results of the dust continuum and the CO isotopologue $J=2-1$ emission lines observed at ALMA Band 6 to examine the existence of small scale disk substructure like a gap or ring structure in the CR Cha disk.
The CR Cha protoplanetary disk is observed at ALMA Band 6 on November 2017 and March 2018 with 47 and 42 antennae respectively (2017.1.00286.S).

findings_qualitative.value: Gas disk (CO to ~240 au) is much more extended than the dust disk

evidence.quote: They show that the gas disk of CR Cha is much extended than the dust disk.

findings_qualitative.value: Foreground absorption at ~4.5 km/s in 12CO and 13CO

evidence.quote: There is a strong absorption feature at the velocity of $\sim4.5$ km s$^{-1}$ in the $^{12}$CO and $^{13}$CO spectra.

claims.hypothesis: Does CR Cha have dust substructure?
claims.result: Gap at ~90 au and faint ring at ~120 au
claims.finding: Gap-ring structure detected in outer dust disk

evidence.quote: There is a dust gap at $\rm r\sim90$ au and a faint dust ring just beyond the dust gap.

claims.hypothesis: Can a planet open the gap?
claims.experiment: Fit Kanagawa et al. gap model to dust surface density
claims.finding: About Jupiter-mass planet could explain gap, but very rough

evidence.quote: Thus, this value should be considered as a very rough estimation.

claims.hypothesis: Can dust accumulate at a gas temperature/pressure bump beyond the compact dust disk?
claims.experiment: HO-CHUNK radiative transfer with compact dust disk
claims.result: Small-grain temperature bump beyond ~90 au; 13CO traces it, 12CO does not
claims.finding: Consistent with observed 13CO bump and ring

evidence.quote: We need further investigation to develop quantitative interpretation in the future.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Dust sintering, secular gravitational instability and dead-zone edge are other possible origins

evidence.quote: the dust sintering, secular gravitational instability, and the existence of the dead zone at the disk midplane also can explain the observed dust gap-ring structure

limitations_admitted.value: Gap not resolved by beam; depth is an upper limit and uncertainties exceed 500%
